name: biomedical-publication-suite
description: Three research skills in one plugin: evidence-grounded biomedical manuscript drafting and revision, a senior-investigator audit that verifies, strengthens, and reorganizes a research project, and readable, reproducible scientific code.

interface.shortDescription: Write, audit, and code biomedical research.
interface.longDescription: Three skills for biomedical research. biomedical-publication-suite finds the strongest defensible story and writes and refines manuscripts, figures, supplements, letters, and reviewer responses. senior-investigator-audit takes over a research project as its senior investigator: it reproduces and verifies the analysis, judges each analytic choice, runs only the analyses that earn their place, reorganizes the repository safely, and redrafts the paper. readable-scientific-code writes and simplifies analysis code that its readers can follow and reproduce, using established packages instead of reinventing them.
capabilities: Humanize scientific prose without detector gaming
Preserve author voice and protected scientific content
Audit and strengthen a research project
Verify reported numbers against the code
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $biomedical-publication-suite to revise this biomedical artifact while preserving its evidence, claim strength, and authorial voice.
